item.title: Good Morning Family - 17 September 2026
item.description:
Good morning Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Thursday, the 17 September.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 4 degrees and a top of 15 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is Z.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter Z?
. . .
